subject: Audit evidence request and handoff: KMS / retention / SSO
messages:
From: Aisha Bhattacharya <aisha.b@pearwellhealth.org>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: security@pearwellhealth.org
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Audit evidence & KMS architecture for upcoming HIT audit

Hi Vanessa,

We have an upcoming Health IT (HIT) audit on June 21st and the auditors are asking for a handful of artifacts tied to our Redwood integration. Specifically they requested: 
- Audit log sample (access & admin events) covering a rolling 90-day window
- Retention policy and proof it’s enforced (which buckets and TTLs)
- KMS key ownership model and whether BYOK is supported for our account (diagram + access controls)
- SSO configuration and recent SAML assertions (metadata + last rotation)

Can Redwood provide these artifacts, or point us to a packaged evidence deliverable? Our compliance lead needs to confirm by EOD 6/8 so we can include the files in the auditor bundle. If you have a single zipped evidence pack that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Bhattacharya
Director, Security & Compliance
PearWell Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Aisha Bhattacharya <aisha.b@pearwellhealth.org>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Audit evidence & KMS architecture for upcoming HIT audit

Thanks Aisha — looping in Ben and Marcus to triage and assemble an evidence pack. Laura, can you confirm if we have a prebuilt "audit evidence pack" for hosted customers that includes 90-day access logs and SSO artifacts? If not, we need to create one and get it to PearWell by 6/8.

Initial asks:
- Ben: produce audit log extract samples + a short readme describing what each log contains (timestamps, actor, route, token_id)
- Marcus: provide KMS architecture diagram and a statement about BYOK support and key lifecycle (rotation, deletion, access policies)
- Laura: confirm retention policy links and whether the retention TTLs shown to customers match internal bucket lifecycle rules

Ben/Marcus/Laura — please reply with ETA and whether you need any assistance (engineering or infra access). I'm happy to host a short call with PearWell if it helps. Attaching a draft playbook (WIP) that we can adapt for this case.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Security GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_audit_playbook_draft.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Aisha Bhattacharya <aisha.b@pearwellhealth.org>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Audit evidence & KMS architecture for upcoming HIT audit

Vanessa / team — I can pull the log exports. Notes & constraints: 
- We have per-tenant access logs stored for 180 days (hosted tier); export will contain event_type, user_id (redacted per PII rules), route, timestamp, and request_id.
- I’ll prepare a sanitized 90-day sample and include a README that documents fields and redaction rules.
- For SSO assertions, ops_team can export SAML metadata and last rotation timestamps; will coordinate with Infra (I need a short window to get the keys).

ETA: sample logs + README tomorrow (6/7 EOD). I’ll attach evidence_pack_v1.zip when ready.

Ben
Ben Carter
Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Aisha Bhattacharya <aisha.b@pearwellhealth.org>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Audit evidence & KMS architecture for upcoming HIT audit

Quick update / plan: 
- Attached a KMS diagram (kms_arch_diagram.png) showing control plane vs. customer key flows. For hosted customers we offer two patterns: Redwood-managed keys (default) or BYOK with Envelope Encryption. The diagram calls out who holds key metadata and where the CMK resides.
- BYOK capability: supported for Dedicated + Private, can be enabled for larger hosted customers after an onboarding step (we document the process).
- Retention: system-enforced bucket lifecycle at 180d for access logs; customer-facing retention settings are surfaced but the backend mapping is the source of truth — see the confluence link below.
- Next steps: Ben to upload evidence_pack_v1.zip (logs + SAML metadata + README). Laura to confirm the exact retention TTL string that we present on the customer portal (so PearWell's auditors can reconcile). Vanessa — recommend a 30-minute bridgecall with the PearWell security lead tomorrow (6/8) to walk through the artifacts and answer follow-ups.

Confluence reference: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/KMS-RETENTION-MAP
HubSpot: hs_record_981273

Attachments: kms_arch_diagram.png

Marcus Lin
Senior Principal Engineer, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
